thesis: The page is a wall of painted Tacoma front doors: every section is a door you open on its hinge, and each door's enamel word-plate names the job waiting behind it.

signature.name: Hinged Door Wall
signature.summary: Flat painted door panels (teal, oxblood, mustard, sound slate) drawn in CSS/SVG, each with a stamped slab word-plate (MOVE-IN, RAIN, OLD BRASS, TURNOVER, LOCKED OUT) and a brass knob dot; sections swing open from a hinge edge via rotateY driven by --sw-p. Hero wall doubles as the tap-to-count lock counter, services are a row of doors, reviews are door-backs, footer is the back door.

palette.family: Front-Door Teal + Oxblood Enamel + Knob Mustard + Narrows Slate

layoutMoves: hero is a 4x2 mosaic of painted door tiles (one tile the duotone porch photo) that is also the lock counter, headline tile + call tile inside the grid
services as one horizontal row of tall narrow doors that swing open on hover/tap to their blurb and price
rain story: full-width pinned deadbolt section diagram (door swells, bolt misses strike, strike moves, bolt throws) scrubbed by scroll
reviews as door-backs: offset staggered panels with the word-plate turned to the town name
footer is the back door: a single slate door full-width, plate reads the area list

motion.intro: door tiles swing open from their hinge edge in a 60ms cascade (rotateY -78deg to 0, 520ms), headline tile last; total <= 1.1s, text present before it runs
stories: rain: scroll scrubs --sw-p 0-1 across 3 steps; the door slab swells 6px, bolt misses strike (red gap), strike plate slides, bolt throws (draw)
services row: each door opens (rotateY 0 to -64deg) as it enters, stagger 60ms (stack)
motion.hover: door panel opens 12deg on its hinge with a 1px shadow line at the hinge edge, 200ms ease-out, pointer:fine only
